This patch collects all programs in an object file into an array of
'struct bpf_program' for further processing. That structure is for
representing each eBPF program. 'bpf_prog' should be a better name
it has been used by linux/filter.h. Although it is a kernel space name
I still prefer to call it 'bpf_program' to prevent possible confusion.
bpf_object__add_program() creates a new 'struct bpf_program' object.
It first init a variable in stack using bpf_program__init()

column2: enlarges obj->programs array and copy the new object in.
